a: NVIDIA's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, released Oct. 28, transcribes 40 languages and was trained on conversations of up to ___ speakers
Music born in the Mississippi Delta
d: Hot pepper, in the New Mexico spelling
n: An open transcription model you can download and run on your own hardware arrived the same day a lab handed its strongest security model to cyber defenders before anyone else. Both are choices about where the power sits: a model on your own machine keeps your recordings at home, and a staged release gives the people guarding systems a head start. Also: Meta is funding research at five universities, including three projects at Ohio State's College of Medicine on heart failure, chest X-rays and dementia, with patient data kept inside each school; and LlamaIndex published a 0.1 draft of a Document Parsing Protocol, 140 rules for how AI should read tables, forms and charts, open for public comment.
